purpose: Keep visual design inside the Universal Creation evidence loop: observe bounded source, screenshot pixels, browser runtime state, explicit caller-authored interactions, and exact before/after render change; normalize reusable Design Genome state; compose and judge plans; derive bounded repair direction; and bind an executed transactional repair, its fresh render evidence, its after-judgment, and its raster comparison into one continuity receipt without granting automatic acceptance or turning measured change into aesthetic truth.

properties.operation: one of inspect-schema, observe-project, derive-genome, validate-genome, compose-plan, judge-plan, materialize, inspect-observer, record-render-observation, judge-rendered, propose-repair, capture-browser, inspect-visual-observer, observe-screenshot, derive-screenshot-genome, observe-render-screenshot, inspect-render-comparison, compare-render-screenshots, inspect-repair-cycle, or record-repair-cycle
properties.path: materialize target path, capture-browser evidence output directory, or local PNG screenshot path; relative paths resolve from the machine root
properties.target: capture-browser local HTML file or directory containing index.html; URLs are rejected
properties.browser_executable: capture-browser caller-selected Chromium-compatible executable path or explicit PATH name
properties.viewport_sizes: capture-browser exact map from every design-plan viewport id to width/height and optional device_pixel_ratio
properties.interaction_recipes: capture-browser optional bounded explicit list of recipe ids and focus/activate CSS-selector steps; no interaction crawl is inferred
properties.allow_synthetic_activation: capture-browser optional boolean; defaults false and must be true before any activate step is admitted
properties.viewport: observe-render-screenshot viewport descriptor or compare-render-screenshots exact viewport id present in both render observations
properties.timeout_seconds: capture-browser explicit bounded process timeout from 1 through 120 seconds
properties.observation: derive-genome input using axm.design-observation/v0.1, derive-screenshot-genome input using axm.design-screenshot-observation/v0.1, or judge-rendered input using axm.design-render-observation/v0.1
properties.version: derive-genome or derive-screenshot-genome version, defaults to 0.1.0
properties.purpose: derive-genome or derive-screenshot-genome human-readable design purpose
properties.genome: validate, compose, or materialize axm.design-genome/v0.1 body
properties.request: compose/materialize design request with goal, exact role/component requirements, viewports, and explicit contrast pairs
properties.plan: judge-plan, judge-rendered, or capture-browser axm.design-plan/v0.1 body
properties.plan_digest: record-render-observation or observe-render-screenshot exact design-plan digest
properties.observer: record-render-observation attributed observer descriptor: human, browser-tool, model, test-fixture, or other
properties.captures: record-render-observation bounded viewport captures with declared artifacts, measurements, and attributed assessments
properties.required_assessments: judge-rendered optional exact assessment ids; defaults to visual-hierarchy, spacing-consistency, and component-coherence
properties.before_path: compare-render-screenshots local PNG bytes for the before state
properties.after_path: compare-render-screenshots local PNG bytes for the after state
properties.repair_plan: record-repair-cycle axm.design-repair-plan/v0.1 body whose source judgment digest must match before_judgment
properties.repair_result: record-repair-cycle published OBSERVED_TRANSACTIONAL_PROJECT_REPAIR result from existing project-repair machinery
properties.before_observation: compare-render-screenshots or record-repair-cycle exact pre-repair render-observation receipt
properties.after_observation: compare-render-screenshots or record-repair-cycle exact post-repair render-observation receipt
properties.comparison: record-repair-cycle axm.design-render-comparison/v0.1 body bound to before/after observations
properties.replace: materialize only; optional explicit boolean replacement of an existing creation target

deterministic reusable design tokens, layout grammar, component semantics, state signals, motion grammar, and material/surface signals
WCAG-style deterministic contrast calculations and responsive/focus/reduced-motion/interaction/coverage gates when required evidence exists
optional local Chromium-compatible capture of real screenshot and DOM bytes using caller-selected browser provenance and fresh temporary browser profiles
temporary runtime instrumentation preserving the original project file and original relative-resource base

browser-observed horizontal overflow, programmatic focus-outline evidence, opaque rendered text contrast, runtime errors, bounded DOM accessibility heuristics, motion timing, and conservative reduced-motion evidence
caller-authored bounded interaction recipes with focus steps and optional explicitly authorized synthetic activation of visible button-like controls only
interaction-log artifacts retaining exact selectors, bounded before/after state, step status, blocked form submissions, and interaction error count
bounded standard-library PNG decoding with verified structure/chunk CRC and measured dimensions, color/luminance/alpha distributions, and neighboring RGB deltas

before/after screenshot comparison that re-verifies both raster byte digests against their exact render-observation receipts before measuring changed-pixel fraction, RGB/alpha/luminance deltas, and a bounded regional change grid
repair-cycle continuity receipt binding before judgment -> repair plan -> observed transactional project repair -> fresh after observation/judgment -> exact render comparison
gate status transition evidence labeled only as FAIL/HOLD/PASS movement rather than visual-quality improvement
attributed perceptual PASS/FAIL/HOLD assessments with confidence and basis when supplied by an identified observer
deterministic repair direction from failed or held gates without automatic source rewrite
provenance separating source signals, browser facts, explicit interaction execution, pixel facts, repair execution, raster deltas, attributed perception, and AXM policy

sits above Asset Atom ingredients and beside Paintgun, Vector Cell, Chameleon, simulation, project repair, and future renderer adapters
keeps structure/style grammar reusable so a reference contributes bounded grammar rather than silently becoming copied page composition
can turn a caller-authorized local Chromium-compatible executable into screenshot/DOM/runtime evidence without adding a mandatory Python/browser dependency
requires separate explicit permission before synthetic activation and confines activation to visible button-like controls while blocking form submission and arbitrary link navigation
can compare exact before and after screenshots only after both byte digests match bound observation receipts
can consume an already-published transactional project-repair result but does not execute that repair itself through the repair-cycle recorder
binds repair-plan lineage, repair execution evidence, post-repair render evidence, post-repair gate status, and raster comparison into one deterministic cycle receipt
keeps browser measurements, explicit interaction execution, pixel facts, repair execution, gate movement, perceptual assessments, and AXM policy as separate truth classes
no layer automatically accepts its own repair or promotes measured change into aesthetic truth

anatomy_refs.basis: Design Fabric can observe bounded local project state and materialize design/browser evidence outside the live machine body while repair-cycle receipts consume existing transactional project-repair evidence.
Material/surface grammar stays explicit while renderer, browser-computed, screenshot-pixel, interaction, and repair-delta truth remain separate.
Motion and interaction state stay explicit design state; bounded browser observations do not silently redefine the underlying grammar.
Source, screenshot, browser runtime, explicit interaction, repair execution, before/after comparison, and external perception remain digest-bound observations rather than collapsed truth claims.

limitations: local source observation is lexical/structural source inspection and remains distinct from rendered perception
browser capture requires a caller-selected Chromium-compatible executable and never installs or downloads one automatically
browser capture accepts local HTML targets only and blocks external host resolution; browser flags and temporary profiles are not claimed as complete operating-system isolation
runtime and interaction probes run only in temporary instrumented copies and missing markers remain HOLD rather than becoming invented evidence
programmatic focus is not real keyboard traversal, tab-order proof, trusted user input, or assistive-technology behavior

activate steps are synthetic HTMLElement.click operations, disabled by default, allowed only after explicit authorization, limited to visible button-like controls, and prevented from submitting forms or arbitrarily activating links
interaction PASS proves only that exact caller-supplied recipes completed without recorded probe errors for the exact selectors and viewport; it is not a usability or product-intent claim
rendered contrast is bounded to resolvable opaque computed text/background pairs; complex compositing remains unproven
accessibility findings are bounded DOM heuristics, not a browser accessibility-tree audit
reduced-motion PASS is conservative and does not infer unmeasured mechanisms
the minimal visual observer accepts bounded local 8-bit non-interlaced PNG only and pixel statistics do not prove semantics, hierarchy, spacing quality, beauty, originality, accessibility, or intent
before/after comparison measures exact same-dimension raster change only; dimension mismatch produces HOLD rather than silent resampling
repair-cycle recording requires a published, validation-passed OBSERVED_TRANSACTIONAL_PROJECT_REPAIR result and does not itself apply or approve a source patch
FAIL/HOLD/PASS movement after repair is evidence-gate movement only and is not automatically equivalent to visual-quality improvement or semantic correctness
external perceptual assessments stay attributed observations and are not promoted to objective aesthetic truth

default rendered-quality judgment still requires explicit visual-hierarchy, spacing-consistency, and component-coherence assessments; browser, interaction, repair, and pixel facts alone cannot manufacture perceptual PASS
a passing integrated judgment or closed repair-cycle receipt applies only to exact supplied plans, artifacts, measurements, recipes, assessments, and viewports and does not grant human acceptance
repair plans are deterministic directions only; no layer silently rewrites source or accepts its own repair
derived genomes retain reference grammar signals without reproducing source page composition by default
persistent_state: none required; optional design descriptors, browser capture directories, runtime/interaction JSON, screenshot observations, render comparisons, repair-cycle receipts, and external observations are caller-selected state

truth.basis: Source signals, browser facts, synthetic interaction receipts, pixel facts, repair execution, gate transitions, raster deltas, attributed assessments, policy gates, and still-unobserved reality remain separately labeled and digest-bound.

agency.basis: Tokens, browser executable, viewports, interaction recipes, activation authority, repair plans, repair execution evidence, comparisons, observers, assessments, gates, provenance, and final acceptance remain inspectable and externally controllable.

continuity.basis: Design Genome, plan digests, observation digests, judgment digests, repair-plan lineage, repair result digest, comparison digest, and cycle digest create explicit continuity across a repair without replacing prior meaning.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: Unauthorized activation fails before evidence output, missing probes hold, digest/lineage mismatches fail closed, dimension mismatch holds, unpublished or failed repairs cannot close a cycle, and even a post-repair PASS does not self-grant acceptance.
